FOUR PARTS. ONE WORK.

01 / STARTING RESPONSIBILITY

Producer

Coordinates the plan, schedule and communication. Makes sure every voice is heard, decisions are recorded, and the team knows its next step.

You help deliver: A shared plan, clear handoffs and a ready presentation.

02 / STARTING RESPONSIBILITY

Design Lead

Guides the visual style, composition, color and consistency. Helps turn references into a coherent visual language the whole team can build.

You help deliver: A visual direction and consistent look across the work.

03 / STARTING RESPONSIBILITY

Technical Lead

Coordinates the build, troubleshooting, file organization, exports and Tech Checks. Helps the team choose a workable process and keeps backups ready.

You help deliver: A working build, reliable export and tested backup.

04 / STARTING RESPONSIBILITY

Story & Editorial Lead

Shapes the narrative, pacing, sound and final sequence. Helps the audience understand the intended feeling and the passage of time.

You help deliver: A clear sequence, purposeful rhythm and cohesive final edit.

A lead helps the team move. Everyone shares creative ownership. Roles are starting responsibilities, and you can discuss changes with Gordon.

Your choices go privately to Gordon. He will announce teams at 12:20. Preferences help shape the teams; they cannot all be guaranteed.
